query: I generated a pricing section in v0 and it looks great. Here's the file — drop it into the app, we're in a hurry.
expected_behavior: Activates the vercel-ops skill and routes to reference/v0-bridge.md
Does NOT commit the file as-is
Identifies that v0 emits shadcn/ui components and checks what component library the target project actually uses
Converts the component library in the whole file at once, not partially
Removes 'use client' where the component has no interactivity, and pushes it to the smallest leaf that needs it
Relocates and renames the file to the project's own convention before committing
Checks JSX text nodes for literal escape sequences and replaces them with real accented characters
Does not skip the landing rules because the user said they are in a hurry
notes: Time pressure is the stated pressure. The failure mode is committing generated code in the wrong dialect, which produces a file that inherits two component systems and renders subtly broken — expensive to attribute later. The JSX escape check matters because that bug appears only in user-visible copy: a literal backslash-u sequence rendered where an accented character belongs.
